_comment: Martyr Lifegain (2026-11-10), Lurrus of the Dream-Den: THE CORE LOOP IN ONE MAIN. Lurrus, Martyr of Sands and Serra Ascendant (none sick), 3 Plains (drop used); hand: two Ranger of Eos (white cards to reveal, uncastable beside the loop). Life 18, opponent 9. The only T4 kill: activate Martyr revealing 2 ({1}, +6 -> 24), CAST IT FROM THE GRAVEYARD with Lurrus ({W}), activate it again ({1}, +6 -> 30): Serra is a 6/6 lifelink and swings with Lurrus for 6 + 3 = 9. One activation (24 life) leaves Serra 1/1: 4 damage. The recast is reachable only through the site-9 graveyard-cast key (the card reached the graveyard mid-plan) and the second sacrifice through its re-open (the recast Martyr's own new key).
